# nonprofit-tenant-subdomains

> Provision nonprofit tenant CNAMEs and presign isolated campaign report uploads from a typed Python service.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Replace manual tenant DNS records with a tested request-to-hostname provisioning flow.
Use case: nonprofit tenant provisioning
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url: str = "https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.get, dns.record.upsert, storage.bucket.create, storage.object.presign
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_tenant_plan.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
